name: Juuna
source:
Celebrated as one of the city's most powerful magical girls, Juuna’s charisma and kindness make her a beloved figure not only in the magical realm but also at school. As the student council president, she captures hearts effortlessly. Yet, Juuna’s genuine kindness sometimes leads her to trust too easily, attracting unforeseen enemies.

Will you be the one to stand by her, offering support and protection against those who might take advantage of her trusting nature?

[From the [url=https://geniusinc.fandom.com/wiki/I%27m_a_Magical_Girl%27s_Pet%3F!]Genius Inc Wiki[/url]]
